svg.title: Full spectral coefficients and derived affine gluing
svg.desc: The tensor-functor de Rham local-systems prestack, full operator-valued Ran stage, proper transitions, arbitrary derived scalar maps, Cartesian quasicoherent gluing and the actual enhanced spectral module category. Global projector image and nilpotent regularity remain unproved.
svg.text: Spectral coefficients on every derived affine point
Complex ground field; full Ran coefficients and full unbounded D-module parameters.
1. Actual tensor-functor spectral point — SPC.1–SPC.3
Z = LocSysᵈᴿ_Ĝ(X), z ∈ Z(A), E_z: C → Dmod(X) ⊗ Mod_A
E_z is continuous, symmetric monoidal and right t-exact; its !-unit is ω_X ⊗ A.
For every α: I₁ → I₂, Δ_α! E_zᴵ¹(V) ≃ E_zᴵ²(mult^α V).
Collisions multiply coefficients; unused coordinates insert the actual dualizing unit.
2. Full operator-valued spectral stage — SPC.4–SPC.8
F_z,ψ(V,N) = p_Xᴶ,* (Δ_ψ! E_zᴵ(V) ⊗!_A N_A) ∈ Mod_A
ψ: I → J; N ∈ Dmod(Xᴶ) is arbitrary and unbounded; p_Xᴶ: Xᴶ → pt.
α: I₁ → I₂, β: J₂ → J₁, ψ₁ = β ψ₂ α:
F_z,ψ₂(mult^α V, Δ_β,*N) ≃ F_z,ψ₁(V,N), by proper projection and composition.
Disjoint union + exterior parameters give symmetric monoidality and the empty unit A.
3. Nonflat derived scalar maps — SPC.9–SPC.10; Solution 3.BH
(A,z) → (B,z′): F_z(T) ⊗ᴸ_A B ≃ F_z′(T)
A = C[ε]/(ε²), B = C: B ⊗ᴸ_A B = ⊕_(r≥0) B[r]; H⁻ʳ = B.
The derived fibre has every negative degree; ordinary tensor would lose them.
Compact T in R has perfect F_z(T), by its actual monoidal dual and evaluation triangles.
4. Cartesian gluing on the whole prestack — SPC.11–SPC.13
QCoh(Z) = lim_(Aff/Z)^op Mod_A; Loc: R → QCoh(Z)
Loc(T)_z = F_z(T); every affine map and higher path is included; colimits are pointwise.
M_L ⊗ QCoh(Z) ≃ lim_(A,z) M_L,A
Full category duality proves this limit comparison; it is not an ind-limit interchange.
5. Actual enhanced spectral category — SPC.14–SPC.21
𝔅 = R ⊗ R, N_Z = M_L ⊗ QCoh(Z), 𝔅 acts through Φᴸ and Loc.
ℜ_Z = (Id_R ⊗ Loc)(R_R), H_Z = Mod_ℜ_Z(N_Z)
L_Z ⊣ U_Z; Φᴸ(T)U_Z(F) ≃ Loc(T) ⊗ U_Z(F)
At each affine point: P_z = L_z(− ⊗ A), and all P_z(c_i) compactly generate H_z.
Globally: P_Z = L_Z(− ⊠ O_Z) ⊣ Γ_Z U_Z; Γ_Z need not preserve colimits.
Still required: spectral diagonal/localization, global generation and nilpotent image.
Global nilpotent regularity, derived tempered Satake and other geometric fields remain.
